compatibilityText.message: Safe, Balanced, and Aggressive keep conversation nodes attached and do not use display: none. Hibernate hides off-window turn children, preserves measured height, and pauses restorable remote media. Hard Memory Saver is a separate opt-in experiment that archives a recognized response before trimming it. Unknown formats pass through untouched. If a turn or ChatGPT control behaves incorrectly, disable the experiment and reload the page.
